 ‘Who will represent us?’ Palestinians react to election delay
 Palestinians have reacted to President Mahmoud Abbas’ decision to postpone the Palestinian legislative elections to September 2027, citing Israeli restrictions and conditions in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.
